meta.description: Independent full-stack developer in Agadir: management systems, AI apps, online shops and websites with an admin panel.

about.title: A developer from Agadir, building software people trust with their work
about.lead: I'm Abdelhadi Bouchadi. I design and build web applications from the data model to the last screen, for clinics, health services and small teams.

who.label: Who I am
who.text: I'm from Agadir, an independent full-stack developer. I build web applications end to end with Next.js and TypeScript, for people who have no time to learn complicated tools.

how.label: How I work
how.text: I start by listening. Then I model your data and split the project into tasks. You get a quote 24 to 48 hours after our first conversation, then I build and deliver.

why.label: Why clinics
why.text: Part of my circle are doctors. I built a tool for a hospital ophthalmology service, and DentaFlow was born from my brother's dental clinic. I want healthcare staff to save time for what matters.
